name: thatopenwebifc-viewer-bundle
description: That Open Engine (web-ifc) IFC/BIM viewer bundle for the VAMS dynamic viewer system
comment: Self-contained UMD bundle. web-ifc is MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft) used here as an unmodified dependency; all @thatopen/* and three/camera-controls/fflate are MIT. three is bundled INSIDE this UMD (isolated from the app and the threejs customInstall) to guarantee a single three instance within the bundle.
